description: This file defines the CategoriesProvider class, which manages a collection of Category objects. It handles loading, adding, updating, and deleting categories, and notifies listeners of changes. It interacts with a database helper to persist data.

classes.name: CategoriesProvider
classes.description: A provider class extending ChangeNotifier to manage category data, including CRUD operations and notifying listeners of data changes.

methods.name: loadCategories
methods.description: Asynchronously loads categories from the database and updates the internal list, then notifies listeners.

methods.name: addCategory
methods.description: Inserts a new category into the database, reloads categories, and returns the new category's ID.

methods.name: updateCategory
methods.description: Updates an existing category in the database and reloads the categories.

methods.name: deleteCategory
methods.description: Deletes a category from the database by ID and reloads the categories.

methods.name: getCategoryById
methods.description: Retrieves a category from the internal list by its ID, returns null if not found or ID is null.
